1.w: A man often reproved hardening the neck, suddenly will be broken, and there is no healing.

2.w: With the increasing of the righteous ones, the people rejoice; and with the ruling of a wicked one, the people groan.

3.w: A man loving wisdom gladdens his father, and a companion of prostitutes destroys wealth.

4.w: A king by justice establishes the land, and a man of contributions tears it down.

5.w: A man taking a portion over his neighbor spreads out a net over his steps.

6.w: By transgression, a man of evil is snared, and a righteous one sings out and rejoices.

7.w: A righteous one knows the cause of the poor; a wicked one does not does understand knowledge.

8.w: Men of scorning inflame a city, and wise men turn back anger.

9.w: A wise man enters into judgment with a foolish man, and he trembles and laughs, and [there is] no rest.

10.w: Men of blood hate a blameless one, and upright ones seek his soul.

11.w: A fool brings out all his spirit, and a wise one soothes it backward.

12.w: One ruling listening to words of deception, all his ministers [are] wicked.

13.w: The poor one and the man of oppression meet together: YHWH gives light to the eyes of both of them.

14.w: A king judging the poor with truth, his throne will be established forever.

15.w: A rod and rebuke give wisdom, and a child let away brings shame to his mother.

16.w: With the increase of the wicked, transgression increases, and righteous ones will look on their fall.

17.w: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest, and he will give delights to your soul.

18.w: When there is no vision, the people are let loose, and the one keeping the Law [is] blessed.

19.w: With words a servant will not be disciplined; for he understands, yet he will not respond.

20.w: Look upon a man being hasty in his words—the hope of a fool [is] more than his.

21.w: One is pampering his servant from youth, and his end will be insolence.

22.w: A man of anger stirs up strife, and a man of rage, much transgression.

23.w: The pride of man will bring him low, and the one lowly of spirit will grasp honor.

24.w: One having a portion with a thief is hating his own soul; he hears the curse, and does not testify.

25.w: The fear of man sets a snare, and one trusting in YHWH will be set on high.

26.w: Many are seeking the favor of a ruler, and from YHWH [is] justice for a man.

27.w: A man of injustice [is] an abomination to righteous ones, and the one upright in [his] way [is] an abomination to a wicked one.
